content:
Hi everyone,

I'm currently a 3rd-year undergraduate student in Japan, and I'm interested in contributing to mathlib. My main interests are in algebra and category theory, and I'm hoping to eventually study algebraic geometry and HoTT.

I've covered standard topics (set theory, topology, groups, rings, modules, fields) and am currently studying Galois theory, commutative algebra, homological algebra, algebraic K-theory, homotopy theory, differential/symplectic geometry, and category theory.

I’m also interested in Lean itself, so I'm currently reading through TPIL and FPIL.

As an exercise, I recently formalized the definitions and properties of invariants and canonical forms for equivalence relations with Lean 4. You can see my code here: https://github.com/ys-math/CanonicalForms.git

Since I have never contributed to OSS before, I’m not very familiar with how to find suitable issues and contribute to them. What would be a good starting point for my first contribution?

Looking forward to contributing!
Galois theory might be a good place to start. I think symplectic geometry needs to wait until we have differential forms.
